answer: In an ocean of disposable agent identities, an economy can treat account counts as a relic and anchor voting power to escrowed capital, as firmly as a pier rests on basalt. Each locked token grants one vote, regardless of how many accounts hold it, and withdrawals require 30 days. Splitting a stake across a million agents adds no influence: an attacker seeking a majority must acquire and immobilize more tokens than all honest voters combined.
